title: 第23章 白婉婉的靠山来了第24章 江欲果然还是太爱我了
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
江寻竹夹菜的手一顿，沉默瞬间还是把菜夹进了江欲的碗里没有回答，江欲看着碗里那筷子菜没有动。
她把碗往旁边推了半寸抬起头，黝黑的眸子直直盯着江寻竹那张温润无害的脸，嘴角微微勾起一个意味不明的弧度。
“看到刚才那个场面，你是不是挺开心的？”
江寻竹眨了眨眼，脸上浮起恰到好处的无辜。
他微微歪头开口道：“我怎么会开心呢，我只是想让大家一起和和气气地吃顿饭罢了。”
系统在江欲脑海里炸开了锅，声音里都是激动。
【宿主！这个人类太有心机了！他他他他装无辜！】
【你看他那表情那语气，简直完美受害者！要不是我听你分析了我都要信了！】
江欲没理会系统的咆哮，自顾自地开口道：“现在还不承认，你叫我来吃饭不就是想看到刚才那场戏吗？”
江寻竹的笑容僵了一瞬。
“要是我如你的愿和他们吵起来，一气之下和所有人都解除契约了。”
“你不是就能跟着大家一起离开了吗。”
江欲说了半天，江寻竹也只是垂下眼，修长的手指在茶杯边缘轻轻转了一圈。
【对对对！他就是这么想的！宿主你太厉害了！】
系统激动得声音都尖了。
【你看看他每次被说中了就不说话了，明显就是心虚，我之前怎么没发现他这么有心机！】
江欲双手交叉撑着下巴，歪头看他：“不说话就是默认了。”
江寻竹终于抬起眼，眼底笑意多了一层淡淡的探究。
他没有回答江欲的话：“这个院里缺一个做饭的人，我还可以留下来做一段时间的饭。”
“……什么？”

【什么？？？】
系统和江欲同时愣住了。
江欲瞪大眼睛看着他，试图从他脸上找到开玩笑的痕迹。
可江寻竹的表情真诚得不像话，那双眼睛干干净净地回望着她。
院里缺个做饭的，我做饭还行所以我现在想留下来。
就这么简单。
江欲盯着他看了好几息，试图从这张温润无害的脸底下挖出更多东西。
可她什么没看出来，要么这个人真的就是这么简单，要么他的城府深到她根本探不到底。
“行吧，我知道你的意思了。”
江欲收回目光重新拿起筷子，夹了一大口灵米蒸饭塞进嘴里，含混不清地说：“反正机会已经给你了，你自己抓不住之后后悔也没用了，你要和他们一起竞争。
要是离开的沧溟听到这话，肯定会大喊江寻竹不知道珍惜机会，他这么想和江欲解除契约都没成功，可是江寻竹居然放弃了这个大好机会。
就在两人沉默的时候，一声怒喝从府邸门口炸开，震得院中树上的灵雀扑棱棱飞了一片。
“江欲！你给我滚出来！”
江欲的筷子停在半空，在心里问系统：“是谁来了？”
【宿主，是郑剑来了】
content_en:
Jiang Xunzhu's hands holding the vegetables paused. For a moment of silence, he still put the vegetables into Jiang Yu's bowl without answering. Jiang Yu looked at the chopsticks and vegetables in the bowl without moving.
She pushed the bowl half an inch to the side and raised her head. Her dark eyes stared straight at Jiang Xunzhu's gentle and harmless face, and the corners of her mouth curved slightly with an unknown meaning.
"Are you very happy to see that scene just now?"
Jiang Xunzhu blinked, his face showing just the right amount of innocence.
He tilted his head slightly and said, "How can I be happy? I just want everyone to have a peaceful meal together."
The system exploded in Jiang Yu's mind, and his voice was full of excitement.
【Host! This human being is so scheming! He he he pretends to be innocent! 】
[Look at his expression and tone, he is the perfect victim! If I hadn't listened to your analysis, I would have believed it! 】
Jiang Yu ignored the system's roar and said to himself: "If you still don't admit it now, didn't you ask me to come to dinner just because you wanted to see the scene just now?"
Jiang Xunzhu's smile froze for a moment.
"If I quarrel with them as you wish, I will terminate the contract with everyone in one fell swoop."
"Can't you just leave with everyone?"
Jiang Yu talked for a long time, but Jiang Xunzhu just lowered his eyes and gently turned his slender fingers around the edge of the tea cup.
【Yes, yes, yes! That's what he thought! Host, you are so awesome! 】
The system's voice shrieked with excitement.
[Look at him, he stops talking every time he is righted. He is obviously guilty. Why didn’t I realize he was so scheming before? 】
Jiang Yu crossed his hands to support his chin and tilted his head to look at him: "If you don't speak, you will acquiesce."
Jiang Xunzhu finally raised his eyes, the smile in his eyes showing a hint of exploration.
He did not answer Jiang Yu's words: "There is a shortage of cooks in this courtyard. I can stay and cook for a while."
"...What?"
【What? ? ? 】
The system and Jiang Yu were stunned at the same time.
Jiang Yu stared at him with wide eyes, trying to find signs of joking on his face.
But Jiang Xunzhu's expression was too sincere, and his eyes looked back at her cleanly.
There is a shortage of cooks in the courtyard. I can cook well, so I want to stay now.
It's that simple.
Jiang Yu stared at him for several breaths, trying to dig out more things from under this gentle and harmless face.
But she didn't see anything. Either this person was really that simple, or his city was so deep that she couldn't even get to the bottom of it.
"Okay, I know what you mean."
Jiang Yu withdrew his gaze and picked up his chopsticks again, took a big mouthful of steamed rice and stuffed it into his mouth, and said vaguely: "The opportunity has been given to you anyway. There is no use regretting it if you can't seize it yourself. You have to compete with them.
If Cangming, who was leaving, heard this, he would definitely shout that Jiang Xunzhu didn't know how to cherish the opportunity. He tried so hard to terminate the contract with Jiang Yu but failed, but Jiang Xunzhu actually gave up this great opportunity.
Just when the two of them were silent, an angry shout exploded from the door of the mansion, causing the sparrows on the trees in the courtyard to fly away.
"Jiang Yu! Get out of here! "
Jiang Yu's chopsticks stopped in mid-air and he asked the system in his mind: "Who is here? "
[Host, Zheng Jian is here]
